description: A page of the extension shown over the main mail window, for the command line. The page name comes from a fixed list and the parent maps it to a page of the extension.

functions.name: mount
functions.description: Shows the surface in the window and gives it the focus. A second call for the same window replaces the first.

functions.name: unmount
functions.description: Removes the overlay of the window and returns the focus to the thread list. Does nothing when none is mounted.

events.name: onClosed
events.description: The overlay left a window by itself: the front tab changed or the window closed. The payload is output only, so it takes no argument check.
